name: Wizard's March
description: The casting out of a magus from the Order, leaving him an outlaw who may be killed with impunity; the default penalty when a convict refuses lesser penalties.

name: Quaesitor
description: Investigating and judicial magi, mostly of House Guernicus, who investigate Hermetic crimes, endorse testimony and preside at Tribunals.

name: Presiding Quaesitor
description: The Quaesitor elected by local Quaesitors to preside over a Tribunal, set penalties and hold a veto; aided by two advisers.

name: Praeco
description: The Tribunal officer who decides the order in which cases are heard and keeps the Tribunal coffers.

name: Hoplite
description: Powerful magi who accompany Quaesitors for protection and hunt down Marched magi.

name: Hoplite Quaesitor
description: Guernicus magi able at both investigation and combat, often sent to lawless Tribunals.

name: Magvillus Council
description: The governing council of House Guernicus with inner and outer tiers, which reviews vetoes, appeals of penalties and Quaesitorial conduct.

name: Magvillus
description: The domus magna of House Guernicus, housing Fenicil's library and ritual chambers, with a magic aura of +4.

name: Tribunal Coffers
description: Tribunal funds kept by the Praeco, receiving fines and paying Quaesitors' investigation costs.

name: Tribunal
description: The regional assembly of magi that hears cases, votes on rulings and must be validated by a two-thirds vote.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: The Order-wide Tribunal whose rulings set law on matters such as Quaesitorial powers and sanctum law; the Guernicus Primus presides.

name: First Tribunal
description: The founding Tribunal of the Order whose rulings provided guidelines on Quaesitorial investigation.

name: Thebes Tribunal
description: Tribunal where the cases of Morwena versus Darius and of Stregos versus Fulmen were heard.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal to which Darius was moved; home to Durenmar and many Mercere magi.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Tribunal in which Harco, the Mercere domus magna, is located.

name: Provencal Tribunal
description: Tribunal bordering Harco where Mercere magi are relatively common.

name: Damages
description: Hermetic penalty paid directly to the victim, including costs; in a March the victim gets a quarter of the outcast's estate.

name: Fines
description: Hermetic penalty compensating the Tribunal and prosecution, split one third to the prosecutor and two-thirds to Tribunal coffers.

name: Punishments
description: Purely retributive Hermetic penalties set in a hierarchy of severity, from seasons of service to death of a familiar.

name: Seasons of Service
description: Punishment in which a convicted magus serves Mercere or Guernicus magi, e.g. enacting longevity rituals, investing devices or copying records.

name: Loss of an Apprentice
description: Punishment requiring the convicted magus to surrender his apprentice immediately to a new master.

name: Banishment from Tribunal
description: Punishment requiring a magus to leave a Tribunal's area and find another residential Tribunal.

name: Loss of Familiar
description: Punishment in which the cords binding magus and familiar are cut, a painful and emotionally scarring experience.

name: Death of Familiar
description: The most severe punishment short of a March, in which the convicted magus's familiar is killed.

name: High Crime
description: Serious Hermetic offences, such as failing to comply with penalties, which may lead to a Wizard's March.

name: Low Crime
description: Lesser Hermetic offences such as failing to cooperate with an investigation or reading marked texts.

name: Quaesitor in Good Standing
description: Status proven by a letter signed by the Guernicus Primus, less than seven years old, without which a Quaesitor has no authority.

name: Investigation Immunity
description: Limited immunity from scrying charges granted to Quaesitors and their agents while pursuing justified investigations.

name: Sanctum Invasion
description: A Quaesitor may enter a suspect's sanctum under forfeit immunity, protected afterward by investigation immunity.

name: Letter of Authority
description: Document granted by a Quaesitor to non-Quaesitors giving them investigation immunity and the right to demand cooperation.

name: Endorsing Testimony
description: Process by which a Quaesitor magically verifies a witness's testimony after the witness lowers Parma.

name: The Veto
description: Power of the Presiding Quaesitor to annul a ruling that clearly conflicts with the Code or a higher Tribunal ruling, reviewed by the Magvillus Council.

name: Arbitration
description: Quaesitorial service mediating disputes between magi or covenants, ending in a formal witnessed agreement.

name: Transitionalists
description: Faction in the debate over Hermetic law favoring change; a Transitionalist council would never use the veto on grounds of tradition alone.

name: Traditionalists
description: Faction in the debate over Hermetic law favoring adherence to the First Tribunal and tradition.

name: Advocate
description: Guernicus (or other) magi who serve as legal advocates for principals and broker out-of-court settlements.

name: Magical Investigation Specialist
description: Guernicus magi called in to support investigations with specialist magic, often endorsing testimony.

name: Limit of Time
description: A limit of Hermetic magic that investigation specialists dream of breaking to see into the past.

name: Hermetic Theory
description: The body of Hermetic magical theory whose boundaries investigation specialists research.

name: Terrae-Magi
description: A cult founded by Guernicus's pupils to preserve his earth magic, led always by a Guernicus magus with a seat on the inner council.

name: Geomantia
description: Divinatory ability possessed by many Terrae-Magi cultists.

name: Earth Elemental
description: Elementals that Terrae-Magi learn to summon and bargain with.

name: Custos
description: Worldly-wise mundane agents, often merchants, employed by Quaesitors as eyes and ears in mundane society.

name: Redcap
description: UnGifted members of House Mercere who carry messages and trade between covenants and have magi's rights but usually do not vote.

name: Mercere Magi
description: The Gifted members of House Mercere, about twelve in number, who support Redcaps through invested devices and healing.

name: Sanctum Law
description: Grand Tribunal rulings protecting sanctums and texts marked with a sanctum mark or House symbol; reading such texts is a low crime.

name: Acute Sense
description: A mastery ability for magical sense spells, available only to those with Quaesitorial training, that detects altered, hidden or destroyed traces.

name: Spell Trace
description: Residual magic left after a spell expires, with a decaying magnitude, used to identify casters.

name: Sigil
description: The unique quirk of a magus's magic that marks his spell traces and can identify the caster.

name: Shroud Magic
description: Spell that causes an expiring magic's trace to show a fixed false sigil, possibly mimicking another magus's sigil.

name: Forceless Casting
description: Deliberately casting with Penetration no more than 0 to avoid affecting other magi with area spells.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A link to a subject used as a target, e.g. by The Whole from the Part, and exchanged to build Portals.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that blocks magic lacking sufficient Penetration.

name: Parma Magica
description: The Hermetic magical defense, which witnesses must dispel to give endorsed testimony; taught by Bonisagus to Mercere.

name: The Gift
description: The innate capacity for magic; Redcaps lack it, and Mercere's was destroyed in the lab.

name: Blatant Gift
description: A form of The Gift that makes the magus more conspicuous, reducing the Ease Factor to notice him.

name: Unstructured Caster
description: Flaw whose bearers cannot learn Fenicil's rituals at all.

name: Mercurian Magic
description: Virtue that may halve vis and material costs of Fenicil's rituals if all participants have it.

name: Twilight Prone
description: Flaw inflicted for the duration of the Curse of Thoth on those it penetrates.

name: Second Sight
description: Ability to perceive through illusions and invisibility; granted at score 5 by Sight of Alatheia.

name: Familiar
description: A magus's bonded magical companion; its loss or death is a Hermetic punishment.

name: Familiar Bond
description: The enchantment binding magus and familiar, the cords cut by Cutting the Cords.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Ritual extending a magus's life; enacting them is common service to Mercere.

name: Talisman
description: A specific type of enchantment that a Perdo Vim ritual can target.

name: Warping
description: Effect caused by magic like The Penitent's Confession; passive oath rituals cause none.

name: Magic Aura
description: Local magical strength adding to casting totals; Magvillus has +4 while Harco has almost none.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Ritual protecting an area; some Tribunals cast an Aegis over their grounds.

name: Certamen
description: Magical dueling used to decide disputes such as competing claims to an apprentice.

name: Diabolist
description: Magi in league with infernal powers, typically Marched immediately.

name: Mysteries
description: Secret initiatory magic whose secrets are protected from Quaesitorial disclosure.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The law of the Order that Quaesitors uphold and interpret.

name: Code of Hermes (Ability)
description: Ability used to judge whether a ruling clearly conflicts with the Code (Int + Code of Hermes roll).

name: Hermetic Oath
description: The Oath sworn by all members of the Order, including Mercere's unGifted followers.

name: Vis
description: Magical substance used to pay damages and fines and consumed by rituals.

name: Scrying Prohibition
description: The Code's protection of magi from magical spying on their legitimate secrets.

name: Schism War
description: The war in which the Curse of Thoth was cast against House Diedne and Redcaps influenced the flow of information.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The medieval setting in which the Order operates.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Order of magi whose Houses, Tribunals and Code are described.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Ancient magical cult whose rituals included Hermes' Portal and whose cremation rites were used for Mercere.

name: Fenicil's Rituals
description: Mercurian or pre-Mercurian group rituals taught only to Guernicus magi, divided into Greater and Lesser Rituals.

name: Fenicil
description: Guernicus-associated figure after whom the ancient rituals and a library at Magvillus are named.

name: Fenicil's Library
description: Library within Magvillus holding books on the Abilities of Fenicil's rituals.

name: Societas Merceris
description: Societies within House Mercere designed primarily for Redcaps, based on covenant, goals, family or creed.

name: Guernicus Gauntlet
description: Written exam on the Code and practical tests of investigation and moral character that ends a Guernicus apprenticeship.

name: Primus
description: The leader of a House; the Primi collectively form an arm of Order government.

name: Philosophiae
description: Ability many Guernicus magi start with, specialized in moral philosophy.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability letting a Quaesitor spot signs of guilt in others.

name: Awareness
description: Ability used to examine a scene and discover clues or recognize sigils.

name: Intrigue
description: Ability to piece together conspiracies and see through political manipulation.

name: Penetration
description: Ability for overcoming Magic Resistance, used in Acute Sense rolls.

name: Finesse
description: Ability used when designing a Shroud Magic spell to mimic a sigil.

name: Intellego
description: Technique of perception, the primary method of Quaesitorial investigation.

name: Mentem
description: Form of the mind; Intellego Mentem may never be used on magi without permission.

name: Vim
description: Form of magic itself, used to detect and analyze spell traces.

name: Imaginem
description: Form of images, involved in deceptions Acute Sense can detect.

name: Terram
description: Form of earth, Guernicus's special magical knowledge.

name: Corpus
description: Form of bodies, used to detect body material like hair and blood.

name: Creo
description: Technique of creation, used to refresh memories and spell traces.

name: Rego
description: Technique of control, used in Mentem spells like Trust Me.

name: Perdo
description: Technique of destruction, used to age traces and dispel enchantments.

name: Muto
description: Technique of transformation; Shroud Magic leaves a Muto Vim trace.

name: Animal
description: Form of animals, a requisite of Veil All Eyes.

name: Realms of Power
description: The four Realms whose effects each require separate spells to analyze.

name: Magic Realm
description: The Realm to which Nemesis is thought to belong.

name: Infernal
description: Realm whose powers can fool any magic; conflicting endorsed testimony implies infernal involvement.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of faerie beings mentioned in comparison to Nemesis.

name: Guernicus
description: Founder of House Guernicus who stressed moral education, had special knowledge of Terram, and prophesied the Order's reliance on his line.

name: Morwena of Ex Miscellanea
description: Magus who in 1030 A.A. charged Darius of Guernicus with a thirty-year vendetta against her.

name: Darius of Guernicus
description: Quaesitor acquitted of abusing his privilege against Morwena but later moved to the Rhine Tribunal.

name: Fulmen of Guernicus
description: Quaesitor who disseminated a convict's mystery secrets, lost his familiar as punishment, and joined House Jerbiton as an advocate.

name: Stregos
description: Archmagus who led the consortium charging Fulmen of Guernicus.

name: Bilera
description: Current Primus of House Guernicus, under whom Transitionalist/Traditionalist views should not affect advancement.

name: Aldico
description: Primus of Mercere during the Schism War, replaced by Mihalyi.

name: Mercere
description: Founder of House Mercere, first to join Trianoma, who lost his Gift and founded Harco and the Portals.

name: Trianoma
description: Founder of the Order whom Mercere served and who defended his unGifted followers at Tribunal.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder who taught Mercere the Parma Magica and tried unsuccessfully to restore his Gift.

name: Insatella
description: UnGifted Prima of House Mercere, nearly eighty, running Harco for almost forty years.

name: Mihalyi
description: Insatella's father, the last Primus of Mercere, who replaced Aldico after the Schism War.

name: Maria
description: Insatella's second-eldest daughter and chief assistant, likely to succeed her.

name: Belin
description: Famous Redcap who wore a loose red cap like Mercere's and always got her messages through.

name: Circe
description: Legendary figure claimed by some as an ancestor of Mercere.

name: Odysseus
description: Legendary hero claimed by some as an ancestor of Mercere.

name: Perseus
description: Ancient hero some say Mercere descended from.

name: Orpheus
description: Ancient hero some say Mercere descended from.

name: Mercury
description: God of whom some believe Mercere was a medieval incarnation; a winged-shoed figure carried Mercere away at his cremation.

name: Nemesis
description: Entity thought to be of the magic realm, hater of immoderation, called upon by the Call for Justice ritual.

name: Diedne
description: Founder whose stronghold was attacked through a Portal at the start of the Schism War.

name: House Guernicus
description: House of the Quaesitores, dedicated to upholding Hermetic law.

name: House Mercere
description: House of heralds, merchants and Redcaps, the largest House but with the fewest magi.

name: House Bonisagus
description: House that aids Guernicus in designing counter-magic and investigative spells.

name: House Jerbiton
description: House Fulmen joined after leaving Guernicus; considered a House society.

name: House Flambeau
description: House whose members value the Hoplite role; considered a House society.

name: House Tytalus
description: House whose members value the Hoplite role; considered a House society.

name: House Tremere
description: House whose members value the Hoplite role.

name: House Diedne
description: House targeted by the Curse of Thoth during the Schism War.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: House of Morwena, considered a House society.

name: Harco
description: Domus magna of House Mercere in Piedmont, a center of Hermetic commerce and the Portal network.

name: Piedmont
description: Region in the Roman Tribunal where Harco lies.

name: Durenmar
description: Covenant in the Rhine with a great library, linked by Portals to the Founders' covenants.

name: Hibernia
description: Distant land from which goods travel via Harco.

name: Holy Land
description: Outpost region of the Order connected to Harco by Portals.

name: Novgorod
description: Outpost on the edge of the Order connected to Harco by Portals.

name: Iberia
description: Land reached by the Redcap trade network.

name: British Isles
description: Outpost region connected to Harco with Portals.

name: Mercere's Portals
description: Invested devices adapting Hermes' Portal that link Harco and other covenants; guarded by House Mercere.

name: The Whole from the Part
description: InCo 20 spell giving a mental image of a person's essential nature via an Arcane Connection.

name: Sight of the Molting Magus
description: InCo 25 spell revealing Corpus material within sight and how long ago it was shed.

name: The Discerning Eye
description: Enhanced InIm spell detecting created or altered images and areas of Magic Resistance.

name: Discern the Images of Truth and Falsehood
description: Spell of which The Discerning Eye is an enhanced version.

name: By His Works
description: CrMe 5 spell refreshing a memory in the caster, used to recall sigils perfectly.

name: The Good Witness
description: CrMe 25 spell refreshing a subject's memory of one day.

name: Ear of Truth
description: InMe 30 spell letting the caster tell whether he hears the truth; used to endorse testimony.

name: Trust Me
description: ReMe 20 spell counterbalancing the effect of The Gift on a mundane's attitude, not counted as scrying.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority
description: Mentem spell whose use in questioning counts as scrying.

name: The Penitent's Confession
description: ReMe 30 spell compelling the target to relate his involvement truthfully; counts as scrying and causes warping.

name: Aura of Inconsequence
description: ReMe 25 spell deflecting casual attention from the recipient, inspired by Veil All Eyes.

name: Tell of the Forged
description: InTe 45 spell like Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits but usable on metal objects.

name: Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits
description: Spell for communing with the spirit of stone, basis of Tell of the Forged.

name: Dream of the Mind That Sits
description: InTe 45 spell probing and perfecting the memories of a spirit in natural stone.

name: Dream of the Artifice
description: InTe 50 spell like Dream of the Mind that Sits for artificial stone.

name: Dream of the Forged
description: InTe 55 ritual like Dream of the Mind that Sits for metal objects.

name: Restore the Faded Threads
description: CrVi spell temporarily restoring spell traces to a fresh state for examination.

name: Bitter Taste of Betrayal
description: InVi 15 spell giving a bitter taste when the caster's Parma is penetrated by new magic.

name: Impression of the Faded Sigil
description: InVi 30 spell identifying Technique, Form, details and sigil of an effect on a touched object.

name: Odor of Lingering Magic
description: InVi 30 spell letting the magus smell active magic and fresh traces.

name: Sight of the Sigil
description: InVi 50 spell to spot active magic and traces and read their sigil.

name: Circle of Clarity
description: PeVi spell dispelling active Vim effects within a circle.

name: Cutting the Cords
description: PeVi ritual used as a Tribunal punishment to permanently sever a magus's bond with his familiar.

name: Wizard's Vigil
description: Spell whose combined magnitude must match a Fenicil ritual's Ease Factor before casting.

name: Curse of Thoth
description: Greater PeVi ritual cursing a magical group with misfortune and Twilight Prone; cast against Diedne in the Schism War.

name: Curse of Mars
description: Greater ReMe ritual cursing a nation to internal strife.

name: Call for Justice
description: Greater ReVi ritual calling on Nemesis to deliver justice; never attempted.

name: Wisdom of Athena
description: Lesser CrMe ritual granting +5 to Folk Ken, Intrigue and Awareness.

name: Sight of Alatheia
description: Lesser InVi ritual granting Second Sight 5.

name: Veil All Eyes
description: Lesser non-Hermetic ReMe ritual letting participants pass unnoticed.

name: The Oath of Truth
description: Lesser PeCo ritual binding a willing subject to tell the truth at trial, seen as infallible.

name: The Will of Alatheia
description: Lesser PeCo ritual binding a willing subject never to perform a specific action; occasionally a Tribunal punishment.

name: Hermes' Portal
description: ReTe 75 ritual of the Cult of Mercury linking distant places, brought to the Order by Mercere.

name: Leap of Homecoming
description: ReCo 35 effect often invested in devices for travel.
